questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “As long as the _____ holds this pedal down, the notes he plays will keep on sounding even when he takes his fingers off the keys.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “holds”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Pedals” part of the Piano article.

questions.proof: The soft pedal (also called the una corda pedal) is the pedal on the left, and is pressed with the pianist's left foot.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Each key is a level that makes a _____ inside the piano hit a string inside, producing a sound.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “inside”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Piano article, under the heading “Piano parts”.

questions.proof: When a key is pressed down, the damper comes off the string and a hammer hits the string.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The soft pedal is usually used only in classical _____ and is normally kept down for the whole of a piece or a section of a piece.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “classical”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Pedals” part of the Piano article.

questions.proof: The soft pedal is usually used only in classical music and is normally kept down for the whole of a piece or a section of a piece.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “_____ have to learn how to use this pedal well.”

hints.nudge: The missing word names more than one thing. Read the whole sentence and ask which of them the article is talking about.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Pedals” part of the Piano article.

questions.proof: Pianists have to learn how to use this pedal well.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “As its name suggests, this pedal makes the _____ sound quieter.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “sound”. It names more than one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Pedals” part of the Piano article.

questions.proof: Like the right pedal, it keeps the sound going, but only on the notes that are being played at the moment when the middle pedal is pressed down.
